summary: Phase 1 record contract passes at feeca3f3. The inventory state vocabulary is exactly {inventoried, missing}: all 30 civic P2 rows hold inventoried, no row holds missing (all 30 sources exist), and no state cell holds rated. The single-line row format parses by labeled fields with the state cell last, so the Phase 2 judge rating and note fit into the Judge cell or into new columns inserted before State without a schema break, and test-strategy.md section 2 already reserves rated, reworked, accepted, and follow-up for later phases. The Phase 4 TSV values break no validator: accepted already exists in the TSV (2 civic P0 rows), follow-up is new but no tool parses the status column (doctor.mjs:236 keys on scene_id; common.mjs tableRows checks only column count). The phase diff db2053f2..feeca3f3 leaves docs/ empty, so the TSV status column and docs/map-review.html are unchanged. Run artifact names match the strategy: check-inventory.sh is the named Phase 1 checker, the Phase 2 vision-review files are correctly absent, and red-p1.log and green-p1.log hold the evidence that plan.md cites. One Nit: the checker verifies the labeled presence of the MAPS rating and note but not their value agreement with bench/sonnet/log.tsv; a manual comparison of all 30 rows found no drift.
